title: Iwaki, Fukushima — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Iwaki, Fukushima: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Iwaki is a city in Fukushima with a population of 340,000. A coastal city in Fukushima with beautiful beaches, the scenic Jodogahama coast, and the famous Spa Resort Hawaiians. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
